description: VaaniSetu AI golden set. Slot expectations: scalar = exact (numbers ±10%), list = any-of, {"contains": s} = case-insensitive substring. expected_intent may be a list (any-of).

turns: How much money does a farmer get under PM-KISAN in a year?
cases.reference_answer: ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.

turns: Are income tax payers eligible for PM-KISAN?
cases.reference_answer: No. A family in which any member paid income tax in the last assessment year is excluded.

turns: Can a tenant farmer who cultivates leased land get PM-KISAN?
cases.reference_answer: No. Benefit is linked to ownership of cultivable land in land records; tenant farmers and cultivators on leased land are not eligible.

turns: What is the land ownership cut-off date for PM-KISAN eligibility?
cases.reference_answer: 1 February 2019; the family's name should be in the land records on that date, except for succession on the owner's death.

turns: How can I complete eKYC for PM-KISAN?
cases.reference_answer: Through OTP on the PM-KISAN portal, biometric authentication at a CSC / State Seva Kendra, or face authentication in the PM-KISAN app.

turns: How much health cover does Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provide?
cases.reference_answer: Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year on a family-floater basis for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.

turns: Are senior citizens above 70 covered under PM-JAY even if they are not poor?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Since 29 October 2024 all citizens aged 70+ are eligible irrespective of income, via the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.

turns: Does PM-JAY cover diseases I already had before joining the scheme?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. All pre-existing conditions are covered from the first day.

turns: Within how many days must a CPGRAMS grievance be resolved?
cases.reference_answer: Within a maximum of 21 days; otherwise an interim reply with the expected timeline is required.

turns: PM Kisan ki kist kis kis mahine mein aati hai?
cases.reference_answer: Three periods each year: April–July, August–November and December–March.

turns: Meri PM kisan ki kist nahi aa rahi, kya reason ho sakta hai?
cases.reference_answer: Common reasons: eKYC pending, bank account not Aadhaar-seeded/DBT-enabled, land seeding pending, name mismatch, closed/frozen account, or rejection in State verification.

turns: आयुष्मान कार्ड बनवाने के लिए कितने पैसे लगते हैं?
cases.reference_answer: Generating the Ayushman card is free of cost.

turns: Kya private hospital mein bhi Ayushman card se free ilaaj hota hai?
cases.reference_answer: Yes, treatment is cashless at empanelled public and private hospitals for covered packages.

turns: Kya court mein chal rahe case ki shikayat CPGRAMS par daal sakte hain?
cases.reference_answer: No. Subjudice matters are not treated as grievances on CPGRAMS.
